rationale: Removes the confusing uniform room-darkness feature that existed in v1.81.0, while preserving real lamp/LED light pools, room fills and compatibility with existing plans. This is polish of stable user behaviour, not a correction of a feature introduced only in this release cycle.

summary.ru: Убрана «Темнота дома»: комнаты больше не затемняются равномерной подложкой, свечение ламп и LED сохранено.
summary.en: Removed uniform room darkness while preserving lamp and LED glow.
